prompts.name: CHOMP — SWAMP SKIPPER
prompts.character: The green upright monster in TOP ROW FIFTH FROM LEFT: fresh medium-green smooth tall rounded-rectangular body, exactly TWO large raised round eyes side-by-side at the very top, dark green expressive brow ridges, enormous open red mouth filled with sharp but friendly white triangular teeth, small green arms. No horns, no eye stalks, no hair crest. Retain the huge mouth and frog-like high-set eyes. Personality: exuberant hungry adventurer.
prompts.vehicle: A compact amphibious SPEEDBOAT-SKIFF-shaped kart on FOUR WHEELS. A deep canoe-like teal-green hull with a tall V-shaped boat bow, cream gunwale rim, wood-toned flat deck strip, open cockpit recessed in rear half, four chunky dark rubber tires on short exposed side axles outside the hull, separate square little outboard motor housing mounted at stern, folded miniature rudder above ground, two small round cream fender floats tied flush to hull sides. Bow is unmistakably a BOAT and has no headlights, grille, automotive hood or radiator. No large fan, no air cushion, no hovering, no roof. Short broad hull with wedge bow and flat transom, low chrome steering wheel. Lime and deep teal with cream trim; restrained nautical hardware, no text decorations. Clear ground clearance.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a four-view character-and-vehicle model concept sheet for a polished cartoon 3D kart racing game.
Input image 1: the user's twelve-monster lineup, character identity reference. Select ONLY the specified remaining monster. Keep recognizable body color, face, horn/spike arrangement and signature silhouette.
Input image 2: the approved Riff concept sheet, STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY. Match the premium soft stylized 3D rendering, warm ivory background, cartoon proportions and material polish. Its vehicle geometry and teal character must NOT be copied. The new vehicle described below has entirely different physical architecture. Vehicle variety beyond colors is essential.
Landscape 1536x1024 or larger. Four spacious panels in a 2x2 grid: top-left front three-quarter hero, top-right straight front, bottom-left side profile, bottom-right straight rear. Consistent character AND vehicle construction across ALL FOUR views, identical number of wheels, details and body proportions. Clean small labels FRONT THREE QUARTER, FRONT, SIDE, REAR. Single compact name header as specified. All views fully within frame with generous margins, complete head/horns and wheels visible. No prose, fake measurements, logos, watermark, or busy setting.
A charming mischievous LITTLE MONSTER, ALWAYS SEATED in an open cockpit with its body supported, hands gripping reachable steering wheel and feet contained in a footwell. Never standing alongside the vehicle. Face and distinctive silhouette readable from race cameras. Exactly four wheels touching ground; simple feasible steering and axle layout. Compact single-seat racing-game scale, believable toy-like construction. The vehicle must look distinctive as a solid black silhouette.
Polished animated-feature / collectible-toy aesthetic: rounded appealing forms, expressive eyes and smile, subtly soft skin, sculpted tuft details where relevant, satin paint, chunky rubber tires and restrained metal. Clean studio illumination with soft contact shadows. Not gritty, not realistic, not low-poly. Do not include the reference footer or brand logos.

prompts.name: BOP — BUMPER BOLT
prompts.character: The purple monster in TOP ROW SIXTH / FAR RIGHT: rich orchid-violet stocky rounded pear-shaped body, two SMALL closely spaced round eyes high on face beneath a heavy curved purple brow, two short ivory horns curving outward then upward, little purple central head tuft, enormous toothy wide grin with triangular white teeth, short sturdy purple arms and pale purple belly. No eye stalks and no third eye. Face should remain recognizably the small-eyed purple horned monster, not the pink big-eyed character. Personality: cheeky tough little bumper-car champion.
prompts.vehicle: A chunky ELECTRIC CARNIVAL BUMPER KART. Very short WIDE rounded-square chassis, completely wrapped by a huge layered dark rubber impact bumper at axle height, FOUR small solid rubber wheels visible below/outside the bumper corners, almost vertical blunt flat front face with two narrow cyan rectangular light bars, no hood at all. Driver sits high in a plush plum bucket seat centered over the flat battery-box deck. Behind seat a compact silver finned battery pack with orange insulated cables, one SHORT lightning-bolt-shaped fin/antenna below horns, single circular rear charging-port motif. Purple upper panels, satin silver edges, bright turquoise accents. Distinct silhouette is a squat soft RECTANGULAR padded platform, not a round UFO, not an egg-shaped microcar, not a roadster. Open top, no tall pole, no roof. Softened blocky construction, readable thick bumper layers.

prompts.name: SPIKE — BURROW BUG
prompts.character: The lime-green spiked monster in BOTTOM ROW SECOND FROM LEFT: stout bright chartreuse-green creature, cluster of small expressive eyes under a jagged spiky brow as visible in original reference, wide red mouth and many triangular white teeth, huge pale cream-green oval belly, ivory conical spikes around crown and projecting from shoulders, short strong arms. Preserve the original reference's clustered facial eye arrangement, and its green/ivory spiky silhouette; do not copy the blue ice monster. Friendly excitable goblin energy.
prompts.vehicle: A compact MINING-DRILL KART: a low OPEN-TOP trapezoidal ore-hopper cockpit tub with tall riveted flat metal side walls, angled dark-green panels and brass protective corners, exactly four small wide treaded rubber wheels on exposed stub axles. A single SHORT FAT rounded conical corkscrew AUGER mounted horizontally at center of the front, pale ivory metal with wide soft spiral ridges and BLUNT tip, carried above ground on a brass bearing ring. No grille, hood or headlights. Small rectangular amber worklights attached to cockpit sides. Driver sits visibly above hopper rim with room for belly and shoulders. Squared rear toolbox and tiny external motor below seat; no pickup bed, no roll cage, no rear fan. Lime body panels, dark olive chassis, warm brass and ivory auger. The tub-plus-corkscrew silhouette must dominate. Toy-like fantasy excavator; no long dangerous-looking spear, no smoke, no rubble.

prompts.name: FIZZ — POP BOILER
prompts.character: The yellow monster in BOTTOM ROW FOURTH FROM LEFT: vivid lemon-yellow rounded rectangular body, exactly THREE large blue-irised round eyes in one HORIZONTAL ROW across face, two small ivory horns at outer upper corners, little orange/yellow short central crest, huge delighted red open mouth full of rounded triangular white teeth, small yellow arms. No cyclops arrangement, no stacked eyes. Personality: giddy bubbly engineer.
prompts.vehicle: A tiny whimsical STEAM-LOCOMOTIVE kart with FOUR RUBBER-TIRED SPOKED WHEELS. A SHORT thick horizontal cylindrical teal-and-brass boiler forms the front half, clearly round front brass boiler door with central star-like valve knob, two shiny brass bands around cylinder, one squat cream chimney offset slightly so it never obscures the driver's three eyes. A low rectangular footplate on four wheels, decorative short coupling rods joining front and rear hubs on each side. The open cushioned driver's seat is behind boiler, with steering wheel reachable and full creature visible. Small rounded coal/battery bunker at rear and brass grabrail. Seafoam teal boiler, buttery yellow frame, copper trim, cherry-red wheel centers. Distinct silhouette: short round BARREL nose, squat chimney, spoked wheels and little open rear cab. No tractor hood, no tall radiator, no roof, no smoke obscuring views, no rails. A playful small racing kart inspired by a toy steam engine, not a full-size train.
